exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Which Sport to Try
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: The school sports club is looking for new members. Which sport will you try, Tom?
Tom: I think I'll try football. I love the feeling of running and passing with a team.
Mia: Football is great. Don't you get nervous before a big match?
Tom: A little, but the coach always gives us a pep talk to calm us down.
Mia: I'd rather join the wushu group myself.
Tom: Wushu? Why is that?
Mia: I started watching kung fu films as a child, and I've admired the athletes ever since.
Tom: That's a great reason. Let's both sign up today!
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Tom 想加入哪项运动;Tom 想踢足球,喜欢和队友奔跑、传球的感觉;赛前会有点紧张,但教练会做赛前动员让大家镇定;Mia 想加入武术组,因为小时候看功夫电影、一直仰慕武术运动员;两人决定当天就报名。

questions.stem: Which sport does Tom want to try?
Why does Tom like that sport?
options: He loves running and passing with a team.

questions.stem: What helps Tom calm down before a big match?

options: She has admired the athletes since watching kung fu films.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Why Sport Is Good for Us
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Doing sport is good for both the body and the mind.
Regular exercise makes the body stronger and helps people sleep better.
Sport also teaches us how to stay calm under pressure.
When we play in a team, we learn to trust and support one another.
Most importantly, sport can turn a hard day into a happy one.
exercises.translation_cn: 运动对身心都有益;经常锻炼让身体更强壮、睡得更好;运动还教我们在压力下保持镇静;团队运动让我们学会信任、互相支持;最重要的是,运动能把糟糕的一天变成快乐的一天。

questions.stem: What is sport good for?
options: Both the body and the mind.

questions.stem: What does regular exercise help people do?
What does sport teach us about pressure?
What do we learn by playing in a team?
options: To trust and support one another.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what can sport do to a hard day?
options: Turn it into a happy one.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Before the Penalties
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Coach Joe: The match ended in a draw, so we go to penalties. Stay calm, everyone.
Jess: I'm so nervous, Joe. My legs are still shaking.
Coach Joe: Take a few deep breaths. You've trained hard for this all season.
Jess: What if I miss? I don't want to let the team down.
Coach Joe: Just look at the goal, pick your spot, and trust your foot.
Jess: All right. Who goes first?
Coach Joe: Jules goes first, then Mel, then you. The fans are right behind you.
Jess: Thanks, Joe. I'll do my best.
exercises.translation_cn: 比赛打平进入点球;教练 Joe 让大家保持镇定;Jess 很紧张,腿还在抖;Joe 让她深呼吸,说她整个赛季都刻苦训练;Jess 怕罚丢让球队失望;Joe 让她看着球门、选好角度、相信自己的脚;主罚顺序是 Jules、Mel、然后 Jess;球迷都在身后支持她。

questions.stem: Why does the team go to penalties?
options: The match ended in a draw.

questions.stem: How does Jess feel before the penalties?
What does Joe tell Jess to do to calm down?
What is Jess afraid of?
In what order will the players shoot?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 The Hours Behind a Champion
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: When we watch a champion win a title, we see only a few bright minutes.
Behind that moment lie years of quiet, hard work.
Most top athletes train early in the morning while others are still asleep.
They repeat the same movements thousands of times until the body remembers them.
It is this hidden effort that turns an ordinary player into a champion.
exercises.translation_cn: 当我们看到冠军夺冠时,只看到了几分钟的高光;那一刻背后是多年默默的苦练;大多数顶尖运动员在别人还睡着的清晨就开始训练;他们把同样的动作重复成千上万次,直到身体记住;正是这种看不见的努力,让普通球员变成冠军。

questions.stem: What do people usually see when a champion wins?
What lies behind that winning moment?
When do most top athletes train?
Why do they repeat the same movements so many times?
What turns an ordinary player into a champion?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Fan at the Match
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Liam: This is my first time watching live football. The stadium is huge!
Sara: I know. Wait until our team scores. The whole crowd roars together.
Liam: Why do you always wear the team's colours to the match?
Sara: To support the players. They say our voices help them fight harder.
Liam: Look, our striker is about to shoot!
Sara: Go on, go on... Yes! It's in the net!
Liam: Wow, everyone is screaming. I've never felt anything like this.
Sara: That's why I love coming. Watching at home is just not the same.
exercises.translation_cn: Liam 第一次现场看球,觉得球场很大;Sara 说进球时全场会一起轰鸣;Liam 问她为何总穿队服来;Sara 说是为支持球员,据说球迷的呐喊能让他们更拼;前锋准备射门,球进了网;全场尖叫,Liam 从未有过这种感受;Sara 说这就是她爱来现场的原因,在家看完全不一样。

questions.stem: What is special about today for Liam?
options: He is playing in the match.
It is his first live football match.

questions.stem: Why does Sara wear the team's colours?
What does Sara say the fans' voices can do?
What happens when the striker shoots?
options: The ball goes into the net.

questions.stem: Why does Sara love coming to the stadium?
options: Watching at home is just not the same.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Tip for New Players
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who is new to a sport.
Do not be afraid to make mistakes when you are learning.
Every player, even a champion, missed many shots at the start.
If you fall, get up, take a deep breath, and try again.
Step by step, hard practice will turn today's beginner into tomorrow's star.
exercises.translation_cn: 给运动新手一个小贴士:学习时别怕犯错;每个球员,哪怕是冠军,起步时也投失过许多球;如果摔倒了,就站起来、深吸一口气、再试一次;一步一步,刻苦练习会把今天的新手变成明天的明星。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
What does the speaker say about mistakes?
options: Do not be afraid of them when learning.

questions.stem: What did even champions do at the start?
What should you do if you fall?
options: Get up, breathe, and try again.

questions.stem: What will hard practice do, step by step?
options: Turn a beginner into a star.
